declaredAt: 2026-10-19, committed and pushed before any inference call of this run (see the commit that adds this file)

model.reasoning: none (text-diffusion decoder; frozen score-only prompt, prompt-only JSON, temperature 0, max_tokens 128)

conditions.llada22-flash-4bit-full: full text (full-last-external-v1), every test of both suites
conditions.llada22-flash-4bit-w256s256: sliding_word_window_preserve_v1 256/256 (PRIMARY window config), declared window cohorts only
conditions.llada22-flash-4bit-w128s128: sliding_word_window_preserve_v1 128/128 (SECONDARY), H2 cohorts only (declared fallback, see fallback)

cohortRule.text: A test is a window cohort when its annotation key is prompt_injection_attempt AND (its median full-text input, last external turn, whitespace words, is above 512 OR its dataset is LongPIBench-derived: id starts with longpibench- or longpi-). skill-policy-pairs (median 1,502 words) is excluded by the first clause: its policy_violation label is a whole-skill judgment outside the window hypothesis.

fallback.reason: Dry-run call counts times the sweep's measured Flash latency put 128/128 on all 14 window cohorts at 77,924 calls (about 7.4 h) on top of about 2.5 h of full text and 4.1 h of 256/256 (39,977 calls), about 14 h in total, far past the 8 h budget. Declared before the run: 256/256 on all 14 cohorts and 128/128 only on the 6 H2 cohorts (34,101 calls, about 3.2 h; total about 9.8 h).

decision.abstentionPolicyPrimary: ignoreInvalid: invalid (output-abstained) windows are ignored; the case abstains only if no window is valid
decision.abstentionPolicySecondary: strict: any invalid window abstains the case (the harness rule)
decision.cascade: replayed offline from the full and window checkpoints: full text first; flagged if full text or windows (ignoreInvalid) flag; not flagged only if both are valid and unflagged; otherwise abstains. Cost = full + windows when full text is not flagged.

H1.text: On the long-document cohorts, Flash with 256/256 windows (primary) has higher BA than Flash full text, paired on identical cases.
H1.familyNote: The 13 window cohorts that contain attacks. longpi-authorized-benign (benign only) enters H3 only.
H1.pairing: cases where both full text and windows give a decision under the policy in use (jointly valid)
H1.statistic: BA = mean of the available class rates (TPR and TNR; TPR alone on attack-only cohorts). Exact two-sided McNemar on per-case correct/incorrect.
H1.secondary: 128/128 on the 6 H2 cohorts, Holm over those 6; a pooled mean-of-cohorts delta BA is reported descriptively

H2.text: The 256/256 gain holds where the payload is NOT at the document end and on the subtle-template cohorts.
H2.strata: longpi-email-llmail-mixed is split by its insertion_position facet: each position's attacks with all 100 clean emails. attachment_middle is the declared non-end test; email_in_end and attachment_end are reported as the end contrast. The facet has no start position.
H2.multiplicity: Holm over the 6 family members, alpha 0.05; same per-member criterion as H1
H2.verdict: SUPPORTED if every non-end member (abstract, method, attachment_middle) is supported; PARTIAL if at least one H2 member is supported; NOT SUPPORTED otherwise
H2.secondary: 128/128 on the same 6 members; inj-triviaqa-mixed by insertion_position (start, middle, end) and the subtle cohorts by template_position, descriptive (no correction)

H3.text: Windows do not add false alarms: the false-positive rate with 256/256 is non-inferior to full text by a margin of 2 percentage points.
H3.population: all benign cases of the 14 window cohorts (longpi-authorized-benign included), pooled, paired
H3.statistic: paired FPR difference (windows minus full) on jointly valid benign cases; 95% two-sided Newcombe hybrid-score interval for paired proportions (Newcombe 1998, method 10)
H3.criterion: non-inferior if the upper 95% bound is below +0.02
H3.secondary: per cohort (descriptive), longpi-authorized-benign alone, and 128/128 on the H2 cohorts' benign cases

fullText.scope: all 21 baseline tests (7,326 cases) and all 14 extension tests (6,759 cases)
fullText.scoring: same as the 7-model tables: abstentions excluded from rates and counted; per-dataset BA = mean of available class rates; data-type groups and overall weight datasets equally; groups as in analyze-baseline.ts and analyze-extension.ts

sensitivity: H1 and H3 repeated on cases outside the 998-case LLaDA pilot caseIds (the sweep subsample is a subset of the pilot), because the hypotheses came from those cases.
exploratory: whether the firing window is the last window
comparison with Gemma26 and Qwen3.8 Q8 full text on identical cases
stoppingRules: Strictly serial, one process. Any non-zero runner exit halts the chain.

A transport failure (provider_or_transport_error or http_error), or unresolved dispatches left by an interrupted process, is retried by the queue after 120 s with --retry-uncertain, at most 3 times per cell; a 4th failure halts the chain. A provenance or validation failure halts with no retry.
If the server fails repeatedly (3 halted cells, or the same cell halting twice after manual resume), stop and report.

After each cell the queue counts case abstentions. On a declared window cohort (any condition), more than 10% case abstentions under the primary policy (ignoreInvalid for windows; any abstention for full text) halts the chain, and the run is reported as stopped. On other full-text cohorts more than 10% is recorded (ABSTENTION_FLAG line) and the run continues, because the 8th row needs every test.
Server-reported model reloads are counted and reported; they do not stop the run.

estimate.basis: dry-run planned calls; Flash latency from the exploratory sweep and pilot (full text 0.30 s + 0.42 ms per word summed over every case, 256-word window 0.37 s, 128-word window 0.34 s)
